verdict.rationale: GitCafe's homepage advertises browsing files and comparing diffs. Its docs index describes reading a repository's commit history, inspecting a single commit, and seeing who last changed each line of a file, which covers blame. Repository llms.txt summaries link to the code and history pages, which supports a web history view. missing for 10: in-depth docs confirming that history and blame are web-UI views rather than API/CLI features, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the web browsing experience.
